topics.label: 具身导航

topics.label: 足式运动与操作

topics.label: 操作策略与基础模型
topics.boundary: 从示教、视觉或语言到物体操作的策略、接口与通用模型；并非所有基础算法或 VLA 都属于本主题。

contract.default: All 95 records; topic selection is optional.
contract.membership: Explicit evidence-linked sample memberships only. Topics can overlap.
contract.related: Related work and resources are visible but not counted as topic research.
contract.unknown: Uncurated is unknown, not excluded or negatively classified.
contract.facets: Methods, morphology and artifact roles are independent. Missing morphology means not annotated here.
contract.limits: Existing source reviews reused; not a new full-paper review. Proposed topic names are not user-approved.
